Both entities offer the add (xAdd) method, which accepts the record and the destination stream as arguments. While RedisConnection requires raw data (array of bytes), the StreamOperations lets arbitrary objects be passed in as records, as shown in the following example:

items.source: Reactive consumption of streaming data sources typically happens through a Flux of events or messages. The reactive receiver implementation is provided with StreamReceiver and its overloaded receive(…) messages. The reactive approach requires fewer infrastructure resources such as threads in comparison to StreamMessageListenerContainer as it is leveraging threading resources provided by the driver. The receiving stream is a demand-driven publisher of StreamMessage:
items.translation: 流式数据源的响应式消费通常通过事件或消息的 `<code>Flux` 来实现。响应式接收器实现提供了 `<code>StreamReceiver``及其重载的`receive(…)`方法。与`<code>StreamMessageListenerContainer`相比，响应式方法所需的底层资源（如线程）更少，因为它利用了驱动程序提供的线程资源。接收流是一个按需发布的`<code>StreamMessage`发布者：

items.source: A StreamMessageListenerContainer may not be aware of any @TypeAlias used on domain types as those need to be resolved through a MappingContext. Make sure to initialize RedisMappingContext with a initialEntitySet.
items.translation: StreamMessageListenerContainer 可能无法感知定义在领域类型上的任何 @TypeAlias，因为这些需要通过 MappingContext 进行解析。请确保使用 initialEntitySet 来初始化 RedisMappingContext。

items.source: StreamMessageListenerContainer acts as message listener container for imperative programming models. It is used to consume records from a Redis Stream and drive the StreamListener instances that are injected into it.
items.translation: StreamMessageListenerContainer 充当命令式编程模型的消息监听容器。它用于从 Redis Stream 消费记录，并驱动注入到其中的 StreamListener 实例。

items.source: StreamOperations allows to append simple values, via ObjectRecord, directly to the stream without having to put those values into a Map structure. The value will then be assigned to an payload field and can be extracted when reading back the value.
items.translation: StreamOperations 允许通过 ObjectRecord 直接将简单值追加到流中，而无需将这些值放入 Map 结构中。该值随后会被分配给一个 payload 字段，并在读取该值时进行提取。

items.source: StreamOperations use by default ObjectHashMapper. You may provide a HashMapper suitable for your requirements when obtaining StreamOperations.
items.translation: StreamOperations 默认使用 ObjectHashMapper。 在获取 StreamOperations 时，您可以提供一个符合您需求的 HashMapper。

items.source: At the low-level, RedisConnection offers the xRead and xReadGroup methods that map the Redis commands for reading and reading within a consumer group, respectively. Note that multiple streams can be used as arguments.
items.translation: 在底层，RedisConnection 提供了 xRead 和 xReadGroup 方法，分别对应 Redis 中用于读取流以及在消费者组内读取的命令。请注意，多个流可以作为参数使用。

items.source: StreamReceiver provides a reactive variant of a message listener. It is used to consume messages from a Redis Stream as potentially infinite stream and emit stream messages through a Flux.
items.translation: StreamReceiver 提供了消息监听器的响应式变体。它用于从 Redis Stream 消费消息，将其视为可能无限的流，并通过 Flux 发出流消息。

items.source:
When you read with messages via a Consumer Group, the server will remember that a given message was delivered and add it to the Pending Entries List (PEL). A list of messages delivered but not yet acknowledged.
Messages have to be acknowledged via StreamOperations.acknowledge in order to be removed from the Pending Entries List as shown in the snippet below.
items.translation:
当通过 `Consumer Group` 读取消息时，服务器会记住某条消息已被投递，并将其添加到待处理条目列表（PEL）中。该列表包含已投递但尚未确认的消息。
必须通过 `StreamOperations.acknowledge` 对消息进行确认，才能将其从待处理条目列表中移除，如下面的代码片段所示。

items.source: The org.springframework.data.redis.connection and org.springframework.data.redis.stream packages provide the core functionality for Redis Streams.
items.translation: org.springframework.data.redis.connection 和 org.springframework.data.redis.stream 包提供了 Redis Streams 的核心功能。

items.source: Stream records carry a Map, key-value tuples, as their payload. Appending a record to a stream returns the RecordId that can be used as further reference.
items.translation: 流记录携带一个 `Map` 作为其负载，该 Map 由键值对元组组成。向流追加一条记录会返回一个 `RecordId`，该 ID 可用作后续引用。

items.source: While stream consumption is typically associated with asynchronous processing, it is possible to consume messages synchronously. The overloaded StreamOperations.read(…) methods provide this functionality. During a synchronous receive, the calling thread potentially blocks until a message becomes available. The property StreamReadOptions.block specifies how long the receiver should wait before giving up waiting for a message.
items.translation: 虽然流式消费通常与异步处理相关联，但也可以同步地消费消息。重载的 `StreamOperations.read(…)` 方法提供了此功能。在同步接收期间，调用线程可能会阻塞，直到有消息可用为止。StreamReadOptions.block 属性指定接收者在放弃等待消息之前应等待多长时间。

items.source: StreamMessageListenerContainer and StreamReceiver are responsible for all threading of message reception and dispatch into the listener for processing. A message listener container/receiver is the intermediary between an MDP and a messaging provider and takes care of registering to receive messages, resource acquisition and release, exception conversion, and the like. This lets you as an application developer write the (possibly complex) business logic associated with receiving a message (and reacting to it) and delegates boilerplate Redis infrastructure concerns to the framework.
items.translation: StreamMessageListenerContainer 和 StreamReceiver 负责消息接收的所有线程管理以及将消息分派到监听器进行处理。消息监听器容器/接收器是 MDP 与消息提供者之间的中介，负责注册接收消息、资源的获取与释放、异常转换等工作。这使得应用程序开发者可以专注于编写（可能较为复杂的）与接收消息（并对之做出反应）相关的业务逻辑，而将繁琐的 Redis 基础设施细节委托给框架处理。

items.source: In a fashion similar to a Message-Driven Bean (MDB) in the EJB world, the Stream-Driven POJO (SDP) acts as a receiver for Stream messages. The one restriction on an SDP is that it must implement the StreamListener interface. Please also be aware that in the case where your POJO receives messages on multiple threads, it is important to ensure that your implementation is thread-safe.
items.translation: 与 EJB 世界中的消息驱动 Bean (MDB) 类似，流驱动 POJO (SDP) 充当流消息的接收器。对 SDP 的唯一限制是它必须实现 StreamListener 接口。此外，请注意，如果您的 POJO 在多个线程上接收消息，则必须确保您的实现是线程安全的。

Advancing depends on the requested ReadOffset and consumption mode (with/without consumer groups). The following matrix explains how containers advance ReadOffset:

items.source: ObjectRecords pass through the very same serialization process as the all other records, thus the Record can also obtained using the untyped read operation returning a MapRecord.
items.translation: `ObjectRecord` 会经历与其他所有记录完全相同的序列化过程，因此也可以通过返回 `MapRecord` 的非类型化读取操作来获取该记录。

items.source: Although this pattern has similarities to Pub/Sub, the main difference lies in the persistence of messages and how they are consumed.
items.translation: 尽管此模式与发布/订阅模式具有相似之处，但主要区别在于消息的持久化方式及其消费机制。

items.source: To consume stream messages, one can either poll for messages in application code, or use one of the two Asynchronous reception through Message Listener Containers, the imperative or the reactive one. Each time a new records arrives, the container notifies the application code.
items.translation: 要消费流消息，可以在应用程序代码中轮询消息，也可以使用两种通过消息监听容器进行异步接收方式之一：命令式或响应式。每当有新记录到达时，容器会通知应用程序代码。

items.source: Both containers allow runtime configuration changes so that you can add or remove subscriptions while an application is running without the need for a restart. Additionally, the container uses a lazy subscription approach, using a RedisConnection only when needed. If all the listeners are unsubscribed, it automatically performs a cleanup, and the thread is released.
items.translation: 两个容器均支持运行时配置更改，因此您可以在应用程序运行期间添加或删除订阅，而无需重启。此外，该容器采用懒订阅方式，仅在需要时才使用 RedisConnection。如果所有监听器都已取消订阅，它会自动执行清理操作并释放线程。

items.translation: 现在我们需要创建 `StreamReceiver` 并注册订阅以消费流消息：

items.source: Stream read operations accept a read offset specification to consume messages from the given offset on. ReadOffset represents the read offset specification. Redis supports 3 variants of offsets, depending on whether you consume the stream standalone or within a consumer group:
items.translation: 流读取操作接受一个读取偏移量规格，用于从指定偏移量开始消费消息。ReadOffset代表读取偏移量规格。Redis 支持三种变体的偏移量，具体取决于您是独立消费流还是在消费者组内消费：

items.source: ReadOffset.latest() – Read the latest message.
items.translation: ReadOffset.latest() – 读取最新消息。

items.source: ReadOffset.from(…) – Read after a specific message Id.
items.translation: ReadOffset.from(…) – 从特定消息 ID 之后开始读取。

items.source: ReadOffset.lastConsumed() – Read after the last consumed message Id (consumer-group only).
items.translation: ReadOffset.lastConsumed() – 读取最后一条已消费消息 ID 之后的内容（仅适用于消费者组）。

items.source: Reading from a specific message id and the last consumed message can be considered safe operations that ensure consumption of all messages that were appended to the stream. Using the latest message for read can skip messages that were added to the stream while the poll operation was in the state of dead time. Polling introduces a dead time in which messages can arrive between individual polling commands. Stream consumption is not a linear contiguous read but split into repeating XREAD calls.
items.translation: 从特定消息 ID 和最后消费的消息读取可被视为安全操作，能够确保消费所有追加到流中的消息。使用最新消息进行读取可能会跳过在轮询操作处于死时间期间添加到流中的消息。轮询会引入一段死时间，在此期间各个轮询命令之间可能会有消息到达。流消费并非线性连续读取，而是被分割为重复的 `XREAD` 调用。

items.source: Any Record sent to the stream needs to be serialized to its binary format. Due to the streams closeness to the hash data structure the stream key, field names and values use the according serializers configured on the RedisTemplate.
items.translation: 发送到流中的任何记录都需要序列化为二进制格式。由于流与哈希数据结构紧密相关，因此流键、字段名和值使用在 `RedisTemplate` 上配置的相应序列化器。

items.source: used for Record#getStream()
items.translation: 用于 `Record#getStream()`

items.source: Please make sure to review RedisSerializers in use and note that if you decide to not use any serializer you need to make sure those values are binary already.
items.translation: 请检查正在使用的RedisSerializer，并注意如果您决定不使用任何序列化器，请确保这些值已经是二进制格式。

items.source: Serialize the value with a suitable RedisSerializer.
items.translation: 使用合适的`RedisSerializer`序列化该值。

items.source: The first variant is the most straight forward one but neglects the field value capabilities offered by the stream structure, still the values in the stream will be readable for other consumers. The 2nd option holds the same benefits as the first one, but may lead to a very specific consumer limitations as the all consumers must implement the very same serialization mechanism. The HashMapper approach is the a bit more complex one making use of the steams hash structure, but flattening the source. Still other consumers remain able to read the records as long as suitable serializer combinations are chosen.
items.translation:
第一种变体是最直接的一种，但它忽略了流结构所提供的字段值功能；不过，流中的值仍然可供其他消费者读取。  
第二种选项具有与第一种相同的好处，但可能会导致非常具体的消费者限制，因为所有消费者都必须实现相同的序列化机制。  
`HashMapper` 方法则更为复杂，它利用了流的哈希结构，同时展平了源数据。只要选择合适的序列化器组合，其他消费者仍然能够读取记录。

items.source: Redis Streams model a log data structure in an abstract approach. Typically, logs are append-only data structures and are consumed from the beginning on, at a random position, or by streaming new messages.
items.translation: Redis Streams 以抽象方式对日志数据结构进行建模。通常，日志是追加写的数据结构，可以从起始位置、随机位置或流式读取新消息的方式进行消费。

items.source: Redis Streams can be roughly divided into two areas of functionality:
items.translation: Redis Streams 的功能大致可分为两个领域：

items.source: Appending records
items.translation: 追加记录

items.source: Consuming records
items.translation: 记录消费

items.source: While Pub/Sub relies on the broadcasting of transient messages (i.e. if you don’t listen, you miss a message), Redis Stream use a persistent, append-only data type that retains messages until the stream is trimmed. Another difference in consumption is that Pub/Sub registers a server-side subscription. Redis pushes arriving messages to the client while Redis Streams require active polling.
items.translation: Pub/Sub 依赖于瞬态消息的广播（即：如果不监听，就会错过消息），而 Redis Stream 使用一种持久化的追加只读数据类型，该类型会保留消息直到流被修剪。在消费模式上的另一个区别是，Pub/Sub 注册的是服务器端订阅，Redis 会将到达的消息推送给客户端；而 Redis Streams 则需要客户端主动轮询。

items.source: On the consuming side, one can consume one or multiple streams. Redis Streams provide read commands that allow consumption of the stream from an arbitrary position (random access) within the known stream content and beyond the stream end to consume new stream record.
items.translation: 在消费端，用户可以消费一个或多个流。Redis 流提供了读取命令，允许从已知流内容中的任意位置（随机访问）开始消费流，并能够越过流的末尾以消费新的流记录。

items.source: Due to its blocking nature, low-level polling is not attractive, as it requires connection and thread management for every single consumer. To alleviate this problem, Spring Data offers message listeners, which do all the heavy lifting. If you are familiar with EJB and JMS, you should find the concepts familiar, as it is designed to be as close as possible to the support in Spring Framework and its message-driven POJOs (MDPs).
items.translation: 由于其阻塞特性，低级轮询并不理想，因为每个消费者都需要进行连接和线程管理。为缓解这一问题，Spring Data 提供了消息监听器，它们承担了所有繁重的工作。如果您熟悉 EJB 和 JMS，您会发现这些概念非常熟悉，因为它们的设计尽可能接近 Spring Framework 的支持及其消息驱动的 POJO（MDP）。

items.source: Spring Data ships with two implementations tailored to the used programming model:
items.translation: Spring Data 提供了两种针对所用编程模型量身定制的实现：

items.translation: 用于负载中的每个地图值。

items.source: Demand-driven consumption uses backpressure signals to activate and deactivate polling. StreamReceiver subscriptions pause polling if the demand is satisfied until subscribers signal further demand. Depending on the ReadOffset strategy, this can cause messages to be skipped.
items.translation: 按需消费利用背压信号来激活和停用轮询。当需求得到满足时，StreamReceiver 订阅会暂停轮询，直到订阅者发出进一步的需求信号。根据 ReadOffset 策略的不同，这可能导致消息被跳过。

items.source: To auto acknowledge messages on receive use receiveAutoAck instead of receive.
items.translation: 若要自动确认接收到的消息，请使用 receiveAutoAck 而非 receive。

items.source: HashMappers convert the payload to a Map with specific types. Make sure to use Hash-Key and Hash-Value serializers that are capable of (de-)serializing the hash.
items.translation: HashMappers 将负载转换为具有特定类型的 Map。请确保使用能够（反）序列化哈希的 Hash-Key 和 Hash-Value 序列化器。

items.source: Learn more about Redis Streams in the Redis reference documentation.
items.translation: 有关 Redis Streams 的更多信息，请参阅 Redis 参考文档。

items.source: Subscription commands in Redis can be blocking. That is, calling xRead on a connection causes the current thread to block as it starts waiting for messages. The thread is released only if the read command times out or receives a message.
items.translation: Redis 中的订阅命令可能会阻塞。也就是说，在连接上调用 xRead 会导致当前线程阻塞，因为它开始等待消息。只有当读取命令超时或收到消息时，该线程才会被释放。
